fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-04-30, the complainant reported being warned by a person near Nallur Park Main Street in Chennai not to enter the disputed property. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-04-30 at roughly 16:55. Chithra Raj submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000303. A person named Arjun Shankar, associated with the number 9000000136, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Padmini Raj (9000000032) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant mentioned a call detail reference and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect reportedly warned the victim at the disputed property.
fields.Keywords: threat, property dispute, witness, afternoon, main street, witness statement, call detail, mobile number
